title: Initiative decomposition
description: One initiative decomposed into its member epics, as `wipctl initiative <id> --json` emits it. One row per member epic, each carrying the epic's own arithmetic; deliberately not an execution plan — entries are the epic verb's answer, and this payload never resolves them. Derived from the record on every call and stored nowhere, so a payload that disagrees with the record is stale rather than authoritative.

closed_points.description: Points delivered across every member epic. The member epics' numbers summed; one implementation computes all three tiers.

total_points.description: Points promised across every member epic, a cut member included.

open.description: Members not yet closed, across every member epic. Never a completion verdict: closed out is not done.

epics.description: One row per epic whose Initiative section names this document, in id order. Membership is searched from the epic documents; the initiative document holds no member list.

id.description: The title's slug, shared across stories, epics, initiatives, and questions, so one id names one thing.
